unit_of_analysis: graph version; the 142 questions share one skeleton, one seed set and one corpus and are not independent graph treatments

versions.test_set: 29 versions: 20 random-half (RND90901-RND90920) and 9 partial (P10, P25, P50 x 3 seeds)
versions.all_reported: every one of the 32 versions is reported, including null, degenerate and fallback-heavy versions

retrieval.operator: E009 semantic_seeded_directional_pilot_v1, direction outgoing over each version's edge file (U file = two-way)
retrieval.parameters: seed_top_k 1, graph_hops 1, neighbor_budget 20, candidate_budget 40, final_top_k 4, distance_penalty 0.02, max_context_chars_per_doc 1200; Sept 25 matrix values, not tuned
retrieval.seeds: one shared MiniLM semantic ranking per question, identical across versions
retrieval.replay_admission: host replay with the pinned runner's pilot_selection is admitted only if, for all 142 questions, final context IDs, seeds, candidates and fallback match the pinned E009 image for F outgoing, F built-in reversed, R file outgoing, U file outgoing and F built-in undirected; R file outgoing must equal F built-in reversed

support: automatic candidate support: the five historical lexical top_docs per question; every exposure result is labelled as measured against automatic candidate support, not qrels

outcomes.primary: Y_v = fraction of the 142 questions for which at least one candidate support page is in the final context with role expanded_neighbor (graph distance >= 1; not a seed and not a semantic fallback)
secondary: literal non-seed rate: candidate support in final context and not a seed, including fallback fills
candidate support in final context (any role)
candidate support in seeds (constant by construction; reported as a check)
mean candidate-pool size; fraction of questions with any fallback; mean fallback items

measures.operator: RA magnetic_matrix: unnormalized D - W o exp(i 2 pi q (A - A^T)), W = (A + A^T)/2, binary simple edges; complex128; full numpy.linalg.eigh; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
measures.primary_view: retrieval_no_faq_lwcc (844 nodes; skeleton fixed so the node set is identical across versions)
measures.secondary_view: retrieval_no_faq (1263 nodes, the edge set E009 traverses); reported, not tested
secondary: lambda1 and lambda2 at q in {0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20}
magnetic_subspace_edge_polarization.v1 (pinned config; descriptor only, never a target)
directed_degree_controls: mean out-degree of each question's seed page (over 142 questions)
measures.mechanistic_reference: mean directed reachable-set size from the seed within 1 hop under neighbor_budget 20 (equals the expanded candidate count); reported, not a competitor
measures.controls_view: retrieval_no_faq (what the retriever traverses); LWCC values also reported
sanity_checks: undirected unnormalized lambda2 (magnetic operator at q = 0) identical across versions within 1e-9
F and R magnetic spectra identical within 1e-9 at every q (reversal conjugates L)

primary.statistic: Spearman rho (average ranks) between each primary magnetic measure and Y_v across the 29 test versions
primary.inference: two-sided version-level permutation test: 20,000 permutations of Y across versions, numpy default_rng(90999); p = (1 + count(|rho*| >= |rho| - 1e-12)) / 20,001
primary.multiplicity: Holm over the two primary measures at alpha 0.05
primary.uncertainty: percentile bootstrap 95% CI over versions, 2,000 resamples, default_rng(90998); descriptive
primary.degenerate: if Y or a measure has zero variance over the 29 versions the test is reported as unavailable, which counts as a null

incremental.statistic: partial Spearman: rank-transform measure, Y and the four directed-degree controls; residualize rank(measure) and rank(Y) on the control ranks with intercept (least squares, pseudo-inverse); rho_partial = Pearson correlation of residuals
incremental.inference: Freedman-Lane: permute residuals of rank(Y) on controls, 20,000 permutations, default_rng(90996), two-sided
incremental.adds_information_rule: a primary measure adds information beyond directed-degree controls only if (a) its primary test is Holm-significant, (b) rho_partial has the same sign as the marginal rho, and (c) the Freedman-Lane p is below 0.05 after Holm over the measures reaching this step. Anything else is reported as no demonstrated incremental information.
descriptive_companions: partial Spearman with each single control
partial Spearman controlling for the mechanistic reference
leave-one-version-out R^2 of rank(Y) on control ranks versus control ranks plus the measure rank

confirmatory_tests.robustness: fit on the 20 random versions (Spearman, permutation p as above with default_rng(90995)); report whether the sign of rho on the 9 partial versions agrees. Agreement requires both rhos nonzero with the same sign. Descriptive; does not change the confirmatory result.
confirmatory_tests.sensitivity: repeat the primary and incremental analyses with every edge incident to an _index page or release-notes page removed (nodes kept): spectra on the LWCC of the reduced skeleton, exposure with the reduced edge file, controls on the reduced retrieval view; Holm within the sensitivity family
confirmatory_tests.contrasts: F vs R vs U: per-question expansion-added indicator; rates; paired differences F-R, F-U, R-U with exact two-sided McNemar and question-bootstrap 95% CI (5,000 resamples, default_rng(90997)). Reported as direction-versus-connectivity evidence; magnetic eigenvalues cannot distinguish F from R by construction

exploratory: every other analysis, figure or comparison is labelled exploratory
claims_boundary: no claim that a magnetic measure is a quality objective; no generalization beyond this Docker snapshot; answer quality only from the author's blind grading
